plainText:
Kimiko Elizabeth Glenn (born June 27, 1989) is an American actress. She is best known for her work in television as Brook Soso in and numerous voice-acted related roles in animation from , , and . In the Pokémon franchise, she voices Perrin in the English-language dub of .

==Biography==
Glenn was born and raised in to a Japanese mother and a Caucasian father. She attended the for a year as a theatre major before dropping out after being cast in the touring company of ‘’ ‘’ as Thea in 2008. In 2015, she originated the role of Dawn Pinkett in .
